datasets.name: ds_kpi_cases
queryLines: SELECT count_if(to_date(created_at) = current_date()) AS cases_created_today, count_if(status = 'open') AS open_cases, count_if(assigned_queue = 'analyst_review' AND status IN ('open', 'in_review')) AS analyst_review_backlog, count(*) AS visible_cases, current_date() AS as_of_date_utc FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_summary

datasets.name: ds_model_vs_baseline
queryLines: SELECT max(CASE WHEN strategy = 'model' THEN fraud_amount_caught END) AS model_fraud_amount_caught, max(CASE WHEN strategy = 'baseline_rule' THEN fraud_amount_caught END) AS baseline_fraud_amount_caught, max(CASE WHEN strategy = 'model' THEN false_positive_count END) AS model_false_positives, max(CASE WHEN strategy = 'baseline_rule' THEN false_positive_count END) AS baseline_false_positives, max(CASE WHEN strategy = 'model' THEN flagged_count END) AS model_flagged, max(CASE WHEN strategy = 'baseline_rule' THEN flagged_count END) AS baseline_flagged, max(CASE WHEN strategy = 'baseline_rule' THEN rule_text END) AS baseline_rule_text, max(total_fraud_amount) AS total_fraud_amount FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.baseline_comparison

datasets.name: ds_score_dist
queryLines: SELECT bucket_lower, bucket_upper, bucket_label, band, recommended_action, txn_count, review_threshold, block_threshold, model_run_id FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.score_distribution ORDER BY bucket_lower, recommended_action

datasets.name: ds_cases_daily
datasets.displayName: Cases created per day by queue (fraud_dash.case_summary)
queryLines: SELECT to_date(created_at) AS created_date, assigned_queue, count(*) AS cases_created FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_summary GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY created_date, assigned_queue

datasets.name: ds_actions_daily
queryLines: SELECT action_date, action_type, action_count, case_count FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_actions_daily ORDER BY action_date, action_type

datasets.name: ds_triage
queryLines: SELECT txn_id, customer_id, amount, is_high_value, amount_band, risk_score, recommended_action, top_shap_signals, case_status, assigned_queue, case_id, risk_rank, filtered_rank FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY risk_score DESC, txn_id) AS filtered_rank FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue WHERE (size(:action_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:action_f, recommended_action)) AND (size(:queue_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:queue_f, assigned_queue)) AND (size(:status_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:status_f, case_status)) AND (size(:hv_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:hv_f, CAST(is_high_value AS STRING))) AND (upper(trim(:txn_id_f)) IN ('', 'ALL') OR txn_id = trim(:txn_id_f))) WHERE filtered_rank <= 50 ORDER BY risk_score DESC, txn_id

datasets.name: ds_triage_options
queryLines: SELECT recommended_action, assigned_queue, case_status, CAST(is_high_value AS STRING) AS is_high_value, count(*) AS txn_count FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY recommended_action, assigned_queue, case_status, is_high_value

datasets.name: ds_recent_cases
queryLines: SELECT case_id, txn_id, customer_id, status, assigned_queue, recommended_action, risk_score, amount, action_count, created_at, updated_at, last_action_at FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_summary ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

datasets.name: ds_calibration
queryLines: SELECT bucket, bucket_order, lower_bound, upper_bound, row_count, fraud_count, observed_precision, confidence FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_gov.risk_score_calibration ORDER BY bucket_order

datasets.name: ds_exposure
queryLines: SELECT recommended_action, CASE WHEN is_fraud THEN 'fraud' ELSE 'not fraud' END AS fraud_label, txn_count, total_amount, fraud_amount_caught, fraud_amount_missed FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.exposure ORDER BY recommended_action, fraud_label

datasets.name: ds_kpi_hv
queryLines: SELECT count_if(is_high_value) AS high_value_flagged FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue

## FE Bar Fraud Ops: Triage & Action

Live from Lakebase (fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash / fraud_gov). Case KPIs, the case list and the triage queue include high-value cases (amount > 10,000) with the amount redacted; dollar totals and score charts still exclude them. Dates are UTC.

lines:
## Triage queue

Top 50 flagged (block, review) transactions by risk_score after filters. Type a txn_id to look one up; ALL shows the top 50. High-value rows (amount > 10,000) are included with amount and amount-derived SHAP values redacted; use is_high_value to filter them.

## Assumptions

* **Synthetic data**: all customers, transactions and fraud labels are synthetic (FE BAR workshop build).
* **Baseline rule**: flag when `is_cross_border = 1 AND is_new_device = 1`. The model flags when recommended_action is block or review (thresholds are the MLflow run params of run d89beaca8f81447780da60ed2ea7c811, shown on the Overview page). Both are evaluated on the same rows.
* **$ figures exclude high-amount transactions (amount > 10,000)**: this dashboard shows the non-pii governed view, because Unity Catalog reads Lakebase as one shared role and cannot tell viewers apart.
* **Live from Lakebase**: every dataset reads fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash or fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_gov views in Postgres at query time. New cases appear on refresh with no sync or job run.
